references.text: Here the commandment about the Sabbath is given, which the Pharisees accuse Jesus' disciples of breaking.
This passage deals with how to keep the Sabbath holy, something the Pharisees believe Jesus' disciples are not doing.
Isaiah speaks about honoring the Sabbath, which is relevant to the Pharisees' accusation.
A parallel event where Jesus defends his disciples' actions on the Sabbath.
Luke's version of the event, which emphasizes the question of what is lawful on the Sabbath.
Jesus teaches about the lawfulness of doing good on the Sabbath, which is relevant to the discussion in Mark 2:24.
